minimal_exact_recovery_contract.sufficiency_rule: Either path A or path B must be evidenced strongly enough to deterministically reproduce the same ordered stream; category order plus the statement that samples are shuffled is insufficient by itself.

classification_of_current_inspected_evid.reason: The inspected role-local primary-source evidence records the fixed category order and that samples are shuffled within category, but identifies neither an explicit realized permutation nor the seed/state plus deterministic enumeration/shuffle semantics needed to reconstruct it. A later primary released code/config artifact could still supply those missing items, so global unrecoverability is not claimed.

bounded_action.continual_learning_relevance: This separates aggregate metric reconstruction from exact stream-state reconstruction: a durable checkpoint can reproduce Table II averages while still failing exact run-state replay. For cross-run adaptation, replayability therefore requires preserving stream-order state or the deterministic ingredients that reconstruct it, not only aggregate metrics and high-level ordering rules.
bounded_action.duplicate_effect_resistance: The predecessor and preflight were not rewritten; this invocation adds one terminal semantic checkpoint only after the required preflight.

tested_scope: Only the logical exact-recovery requirements for the already-inspected NC-TFAD VisA Table II within-category shuffle realization were classified from role-local predecessor facts.
